subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Exhaust System
description: A fast breakdown of The Exhaust System for builders.

hook.text: Most drivers think the exhaust just removes fumes, but it deeply affects engine power.

buildup.text: Headers with tuned lengths use gas pulses to help scavenge spent gases from the cylinders.

discovery.text: The catalytic converter transforms toxic carbon monoxide and nitrogen oxides into harmless gases.

twist.text: A too-restrictive exhaust robs power, but a too-free one loses low-end torque and boosts noise.

climax.text: Modern exhausts balance emissions, noise regulations, and performance in a single pipe system.

punchline.text: The pipe after the engine matters as much as the one before it.

quiz.question: What does a catalytic converter do?
options: Converts toxic gases into harmless ones
